content: The effects of this medication on human sperm are currently unknown. However, based on studies conducted on animal cells, the manufacturer advises waiting for a specific period after completing griseofulvin treatment before attempting to father a child. It is also unclear whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of severe side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. It is essential to maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription drugs, over-the-counter medications, and herbal supplements, and share this information with your doctor and pharmacist. This medication may reduce the effectiveness of hormonal birth control methods, such as pills, patches, or rings, potentially leading to pregnancy. Consult your doctor or pharmacist to determine if you should use additional reliable birth control methods while taking this medication. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911) immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can reach the poison control center at 1-800-222-1222. This medication has been prescribed specifically for your current condition and should not be used for other purposes. While taking this medication, laboratory and medical tests, such as kidney and liver function tests or complete blood counts, should be conducted as recommended by your healthcare provider. Ensure you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. To manage and prevent reinfection, consult your doctor or pharmacist for advice. Fungal infections tend to spread easily in warm, moist environments, so take appropriate precautions. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
